messages:
mara: CI smoke suite is red on shard 12 — seeing a cluster of 403s when tests hit hosted API streaming + tool-call flows. Can someone kick a rerun and triage?

josh: Seen that locally too, looks intermittent. Quick log snippet from the runner: `403 Forbidden - kid mismatch` repeated for ~10 requests, then passes. :thinking_face:

ci-bot: build 7872 (sha a1b2c3) failed: hosted-integ-smoke shard=12 tests=12/120 failed (exit 1) — rerun available at https://ci.internal/rebuild/7872 :rotating_light:

mara: Thanks — can we rerun shard 12 only? No need to burn all shards. Also tagging @alex for auth rotation history.

alex: I can rerun shard 12. FYI we rotated JWKS for hosted proxy last night but deployed a compatibility shim; possible edgecases where kid order changed. I suspect the test harness races reading a stale JWKS cache.

josh: If it's JWKS, short repro: run smoke with env var `HOSTED_API_JWKS_TTL=0` and hammer the streaming toolcall endpoint. I saw `jwt: kid mismatch` in the auth-proxy logs.

mara: Can you paste the exact failing request/response (redacted) and the proxy log tail? That will help decide bisect vs rerun.

josh: Paste below (redacted):
```
REQ POST /v1/stream
Headers: Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
RESP 403 {"error":"invalid_kid","msg":"kid not found in current JWKS"}
```
proxy tail: `2024-09-04T11:12:34Z auth-proxy ERROR kid_lookup failed for kid=abc123 (jwks_cache_ver=4)`

mara: OK that aligns with the JWKS race. Alex — can you verify the shim is incrementally falling back to remote fetch on miss?

alex: It should. I'll validate and share logs. Meanwhile can we rerun shard 12 and shard 18 (same runner) to see if flakes persist across nodes?

mara: Yep please. Josh — can you also add a short smoke retry in the test harness (2 retries) and push a patch to the CI job so we know if it's purely transient vs deterministic? Keep retries behind a flag `SMOKE_FLAKE_RETRY=1`.

josh: On it. Opening a tiny PR now and will trigger reruns after CI patch lands.

ci-bot: rerun requested for build 7872: rerunning shards [12,18] (user=alex)

sre-bot: Note: if reruns fail, please request a bisect with exact failing test IDs and include `--collect-only` logs for test ordering. I'll reserve a dev machine for live debugging. :white_check_mark:

mara: Great, let's reconvene after reruns. If both flakes repro consistently, we'll cut a hotfix to JWKS shim and do a quick canary rollout. Thanks team :thumbsup:

tanya: quick FYI for postmortem — add CI job ID and runner hostname to the PM notes, saved time last time.

mara: Will do.
